profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: I love working on interesting and challenging projects that are designed to benefit and uplift people everywhere. I have experience working on Android mobile development, frontend and backend development. I also do my own projects in my free time. My goal is to constantly be learning something new every day.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led the Poland focused Visa Mobile Android team developing and launching the app, organizing sprints, and being the point of contact with designers, PM/PO, and release engineering teams
• Implemented Android infrastructure for Visa Mobile including Gradle Enterprise, TestFairy, linting, detect, CI/CD, jacoco coverage, junit, and setting up build environment within Visa proxy network
• Led effort to improve Android app sign in performance by up to 50%, increase coverage from 0 to ~80%, on call to fix all bugs less than 24 hours from reporting
• Championed the effort to modernize the Click to Pay codebase with TypeScript
• Developed backend micro services for a critical checkout project from scratch in a short timeframe for big clients. Served as a lead on many features on the Java Spring Framework backend and NextJS frontend teams
• Served as mentor and tutor for interns and developers for different teams, highly active in recruiting and interviewing new talent for Visa
• Managed updating dependencies, championed designing accessibility into the app, introduced visual regression testing, used Tableau and Google Analytics to investigate and solve a 10% conversion rate drop

positions.title: Founder at Kerinova
positions.description:
• Managed the full development, release, and support cycle for apps and software on various platforms
• Published over 10 mobile applications and software tools across Android, Windows, Windows Phone, UWP, and web platforms with over 35,000 downloads across ~100 countries

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Managed customer support requests, and deployed system images and software on many systems 
• Participated in meetings with vendors as the department was looking into solutions for remote customer support, seamless cloud updates, and moving user and company data to VM servers.

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Austin

honors.title: Business Professionals of America National Finalist
honors.description: Won 5th and 7th place in National level competition for C# programming as part of Business Professionals of America in both 2015 and 2017.

projects.title: Nova Summarize
projects.description: Nova Summary is a web app that uses web scraping and machine learning techniques to read many articles about a user given topic and generate a summary of the topic from the articles. Nova Summary is implemented in Python for the machine learning core functions and Flask, HTML and JavaScript for the web interface.

projects.title: Nova Fact
projects.description:
• Cross platform application for Android and Windows platforms
 • Presents randomly generated facts and multiple-choice questions created from Wikipedia articles 
• Implements particular features for each platform, including Acrylic on Windows, and Material on Android
